steps.script:
tell application "Calendar"
	set evStart to current date
	set evEnd to current date
	set hours of evEnd to (hours of evEnd) + 1
	make new event at end of events of calendar "Home" with properties {summary:"New Event", start date:evStart, end date:evEnd}
	return "created"
end tell
